description: Derived extract of Experiment 013's recorded per-pair self-attention weight changes ΔA_h(p_c,p_c) of the sixteen layer-1–2 heads and its direct pattern-change read (remainder_direct_pattern_change) over its 2724 exposed pairs and its 864 + 144 confirmed pairs. Experiment 015 recomputes these and requires agreement within 1e-6.
